correctness.rationale: Conservation gives a single particle current J. Writing z_i=Pr(hole at i)/w_i gives p z_(i+1)-q z_i=J/(w_i w_(i+1)). Iterating around the cycle and normalizing gives J=(p^n-q^n)/Z*, with Z*=sum_(i,j) w_i p^j q^(n-1-j)/(w_(i+j) w_(i+j+1))>0. Independent symbolic replay (python /workspace/branches/replay_trap.py) gives 8abcd Z*=P and 2(p^4-q^4)=epsilon(1+epsilon^2), and also reproduces the three-site formula. An independent generator-cofactor check agrees. Subtracting denominators at opposite biases gives even-current sign -sgn(Delta) at every nonzero interior bias; expansion gives the stated quadratic coefficient. All rates of the balanced-opposite-sums witness (1,2,4,3) are distinct, so it has no reflection. The three-site and single-particle boundaries are odd and the proof makes no general multi-particle claim. The packaged verifier was inspected, not executed.
